title: Cinema Studio 4 is now LIVE on Higgsfield.
description:
What's new:
- 30+ new Camera Movement presets
- 2-source Video Lighting Console
- Color Grading with 50+ palettes
- Acting Console with 6 emotions at 3 intensity levels
- Video Extend with forward, bridge or backward generation
- Scene-level edit inside a single generation
- New asset management for collaborative work
- New Сamera, Lens and Aperture options

Direct your films, commercials and music videos with full production control in Cinema Studio 4, now on Higgsfield.
